To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Any and all documents related to "Bryant Turhan Emmerson Moreland", "Bryant Moreland", "EDP445". Every single document. Any reports, complaints, tips received, email correspondence, court orders etc. Any documents as well related to any interrogations, investigations into any criminal activity, police reports, calls, records, organizations that have reported or looked into him that you may have record of, body cam footage, police interactions, CPS or welfare calls, 911 calls, filings, complaints, or absolutely anything related to Bryant Moreland primarily in a criminal regard. Any legal proceedings, any lawsuits, current criminal investigations or proceedings of any kind, past criminal investigations or proceedings of any kind, court cases, arrests, summons, subpoenas, etc. Absolutely any and all documents related to "EDP445", "Bryant Turhan Emmerson Moreland", "Bryant Moreland".

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

John Doe Smith

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

September 24, 2026

Deschutes County District Attorney's Office
Attn: Public Records Request
1164 NW Bond Street
Bend, Oregon 97703
info@dcda.us

Re: Public Records Request under the Oregon Public Records Law, ORS 192.311 to 192.478

To the Records Custodian:

Under the Oregon Public Records Law, I request copies of the records described below.

Records requested

All email communications sent from or received by any dcda.us email account that reference Tristann Harrison, including replies, forwards, and attachments, exchanged with any of the following:

1. Agencies: Deschutes County Circuit Court; Deschutes County Jail; Deschutes County Parole and Probation, including Carla Botello; City of Bend; and Bend Police Department.
2. Attorneys and firms: All attorneys at Deschutes Defenders, Atlas Law Group, and Bend Attorney Group.
3. Individuals: Thomas Spear, Ronald D. Allen Jr, Joel Wirtz, Sarah Yates, Dylan Potter, Daniel Adlaf, Mary Anderson, Kyle Fleming, Joe Langerman,Tammy Plummer, Narci Norgaard.

Date range: March 1, 2026 through the date of this request.

Custodians: This request covers all email accounts on the dcda.us domain. It also covers personal email accounts to the extent they were used to conduct public business.

Search terms: At a minimum, search for the following terms:

- "Tristann Harrison"
- "Tristann Melanie Harrison"
- "Tristann"
- tristannharrison@gmail.com
- 25CR33678
- 24CR46826
- 24CN04000
- 24CN03231
- 26CN01129
- 25CN03004
- 25SK02786
- 24PO04004

Format

Please produce responsive records in native electronic format (.eml, .msg, or PST export), including the full raw message source, complete header fields, metadata, and attachments intact via digital file or link. Paper printouts, or PDFs without full header information, do not satisfy this request.

Requester is the subject of the records

I am the subject of the records requested. I waive any privacy interest in my own information, so the personal privacy exemption at ORS 192.355(2) does not apply to information about me.

Exemptions and redactions

If the office withholds or redacts any record or portion of a record, I request a written statement for each record that:

1. Identifies the record by date, sender, and recipient.
2. Cites the specific statutory exemption relied on.
3. For any conditional exemption under ORS 192.345, explains how the office determined that the public interest in disclosure is outweighed.

Under ORS 192.338, please segregate and release all nonexempt portions of any record that is partially exempt.

Communications between the office and defense counsel or other outside parties are not protected by attorney-client privilege, because those parties are not clients of the office. I expect any privilege or work product claim to be asserted specifically and not in blanket form.

Fees

Under ORS 192.324(5), I request a waiver of all fees. Disclosure of these records is in the public interest because they will show the public through the media how a public prosecutor's office communicates with courts, corrections, supervision, law enforcement, and defense counsel in the course of public business. If the office denies the waiver, please provide a written fee estimate before incurring costs above $100.00.

Timeline and production

Under ORS 192.329, please acknowledge this request within five business days. Please complete it, or provide the required written explanation, within fifteen business days after acknowledgment. If the full response will take longer, please produce records on a rolling basis as they become available.

Preservation

Please preserve all potentially responsive records until this request is fully resolved, including any appeal.

Please send responses and records to:

Tristann Melanie Harrison
63810 Hunters Circle
Bend, OR 97701
458-206-8606
tristannharrison@gmail.com

Thank you.

Tristann Melanie Harrison

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Tristann Harrison
